description: List Hostsmith sites in the user's account. Returns each site's `siteId`, `subdomain`, `domain`, and current status - feed `siteId` into `get_site`, `deploy_files`, `deploy_create_upload`, or `delete_site`. This is the source of truth for "does the user already have a site at FQDN X" - call it before any create/deploy/delete to resolve the user's site reference. By default queries all data partitions and merges the results; pass `partition: "us"` or `"eu"` to limit the query.

partition.description: Filter by data partition. Omit to query all partitions.

name: list_sites
